'''Norio''' (Japanese: '''ナリオ''' ''Nario'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP173|Wobbu-Palooza!]]'' He is a resident of the [[Wobbuffet Village]], and loves {{p|Wobbuffet}} as much as everyone else who lives in the village. His name in the English [[dub]] was only revealed through the closed captions available on [[Prime Video]].

He was outraged when he heard someone had started attacking the Wobbuffet in the village, and like {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}} and {{an|Brock}}, whom he just recently met, quickly pointed the finger at {{TRT}}.

He recalled a story of last year's Wobbuffet Festival, when Wobbuffet were attacked too to Ash and {{ashfr}}. A resident named Lulu beat [[Wobbuffet Festival crashers|the attackers]] with her own Wobbuffet. With the new attack, he went to find her and [[Officer Jenny]]. He then brought them to the scene where the Festival crashers showed up once again.
